meaning: A person you know well and like to spend time with.
example: My best friend lives in the next street.
exampleTamil: என் உயிர் நண்பன் அடுத்த தெருவில் வசிக்கிறான்.

meaning: A gathering where people eat, talk, dance and enjoy together.
example: We are having a party at home on Saturday.

meaning: To move your body to music.
example: She loves to dance at family weddings.

meaning: A piece of music with words that you sing.
example: This song always makes me happy.
exampleTamil: இந்தப் பாடல் எப்போதும் எனக்கு மகிழ்ச்சி தருகிறது.

meaning: Sounds made by voices or instruments that are nice to listen to.
example: I listen to music while I cook.

meaning: A game where two teams kick a ball and try to score goals.
example: The boys play football in the ground every evening.
exampleTamil: சிறுவர்கள் தினமும் மாலை மைதானத்தில் கால்பந்து விளையாடுகிறார்கள்.

meaning: A place where you go to watch films on a big screen.
example: Let us go to the cinema this Sunday.

meaning: A story shown on a screen with actors, also called a movie.
example: We watched a funny film last night.
exampleTamil: நேற்று இரவு ஒரு நகைச்சுவைத் திரைப்படம் பார்த்தோம்.

meaning: A man or woman who plays a role in films or plays.
example: My favourite actor is coming to our city.
exampleTamil: என் விருப்பமான நடிகர் எங்கள் நகரத்துக்கு வருகிறார்.

meaning: A person who sings songs.
example: She is a famous singer in Tamil Nadu.

meaning: A live music show in front of many people.
example: We bought tickets for the concert.

meaning: A boy or man in a romantic relationship with someone.
example: She introduced her boyfriend to her parents.

meaning: A girl or woman in a romantic relationship with someone.
example: He took his girlfriend out for dinner.
exampleTamil: அவன் தன் காதலியை இரவு உணவுக்கு அழைத்துச் சென்றான்.

meaning: Two people who are married or in a relationship.
example: The young couple walked on the beach.

meaning: A person who shares a room or flat with you.
example: My roommate cooks very well.
exampleTamil: என் அறைத் தோழன் மிக நன்றாகச் சமைப்பான்.

meaning: A group of people who meet to share an interest or activity.
example: He joined the cricket club in our town.
exampleTamil: அவன் எங்கள் ஊரின் கிரிக்கெட் மன்றத்தில் சேர்ந்தான்.

meaning: A person who belongs to a group or club.
example: She is a member of the library.

meaning: A group of people who play music together.
example: The college band played at the function.

meaning: A musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers.
example: My brother is learning to play the guitar.

meaning: A musical instrument that you hit to make a beat.
example: The boy beat the drum with two sticks.
exampleTamil: அந்தச் சிறுவன் இரண்டு குச்சிகளால் மேளம் அடித்தான்.

meaning: Gliding on wheels or ice using special shoes.
tamil: சறுக்கு விளையாட்டு, சக்கரம் அல்லது பனிக் காலணியில் சறுக்குதல்
example: The children go skating near the park every evening.
exampleTamil: குழந்தைகள் தினமும் மாலையில் பூங்கா அருகே சறுக்கு விளையாடுகிறார்கள்.

meaning: A game where two players hit a ball over a net with rackets.
tamil: டென்னிஸ், மட்டையால் பந்தை வலைக்கு மேல் அடித்து ஆடும் விளையாட்டு
example: My brother plays tennis every morning.
exampleTamil: என் அண்ணன் தினமும் காலையில் டென்னிஸ் விளையாடுகிறான்.

meaning: A game where players hit a shuttlecock over a net with rackets.
example: We play badminton in the street after school.

meaning: A light toy that flies in the wind on a long string.
example: The children flew a kite on the terrace.

meaning: A colourful rubber bag filled with air or gas.
example: He blew up ten balloons for the party.
